title: Benchmarking Intra-Patient 3D Deformable Multimodal Image Registration
abstract: arXiv:2609.15669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal image registration is a key component of many clinical workflows, yet it remains challenging because corresponding anatomical structures often exhibit substantially different image intensities across modalities. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, including both synthetic deformation recovery and real clinical scenarios. We evaluate classical optimization-based approaches and modern learning-based methods, including recent deep learning and foundation models, using complementary metrics: Average Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), average 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and a modality-independent structural similarity measure based on the MIND self-similarity context (MIND-SSC). Results show high variability across datasets, with learning-based methods demo

translated_title: 患者内部3D可变形多模态图像配准方法的基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态图像配准是许多临床工作流程中的关键组成部分，但由于相应的解剖结构在不同模态下往往表现出显著不同的图像强度，因此它仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全面的患者内部3D多模态可变形配准方法的基准测试，涵盖三个数据集，包含不同的解剖区域和难度级别，既包括合成形变恢复任务，也包括真实临床场景。我们使用互补的评估指标——平均Dice相似系数（DSC）、平均95百分位Hausdorff距离（HD95）以及基于MIND自相似上下文的模态无关结构相似性度量（MIND-SSC）——对经典的基于优化的方法和现代基于学习的方法（包括最新的深度学习方法和基础模型）进行了评估。结果显示各数据集之间存在高度变异性，基于学习的方法表现……
tldr: 本文对三个涵盖不同解剖区域和难度级别的数据集上的患者内部3D多模态可变形图像配准方法进行了全面基准测试，使用DSC、HD95和MIND-SSC等互补指标评估了经典优化方法和现代学习方法（包括深度学习和基础模型）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable image registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, evaluating classical optimization-based and modern learning-based approaches (including deep learning and foundation models) using complementary metrics such as DSC, HD95, and MIND-SSC.
